AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/SceneViewGestures.qml
IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0
    TRAVERSE TouchArea
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
    INSERT {
        TouchAreaClickFilter {
            id: translateGestureFilter
            palmAreaThreshold: touchArea.tapPalmThreshold
            enabled: !touchArea.panAndZoomOnly
            fingers: 3
            onClick: {
                translatePopup.originalText = "";
                translatePopup.translationText = "";
                translatePopup.exampleText = "";
                translatePopup.exampleTranslationText = "";
                translatePopup.lastSeq = translatePopup.readSeq();
                translatePopup.mode = "translate";
                translatePopup.loadingLabel = "翻译中…";
                translatePopup.state = "loading";
                translatePopup.x = (touchArea.width - translatePopup.width) / 2;
                translatePopup.y = touchArea.height * 0.3;
                translatePopup.visible = true;
                translateTriggerCmd.executeCommand("/bin/touch", ["/home/root/xovi/exthome/translate/trigger"]);
                console.log("translate: gesture fired, trigger touched");
                translatePollTimer.elapsedMs = 0;
                translatePollTimer.start();
            }
        }

        CommandExecutor {
            id: translateTriggerCmd
        }

        FontLoader {
            id: translateFontLoader
            source: "file:///home/root/xovi/exthome/translate/NotoSansSC.ttf"
        }

        // A separate statically-instanced Bold-weight font file, not just
        // font.bold:true over the variable-weight regular font above —
        // synthetic/variable-axis bold rendered visibly too thin on
        // device, a real bold face reads much more solid on e-ink.
        FontLoader {
            id: translateBoldFontLoader
            source: "file:///home/root/xovi/exthome/translate/NotoSansSC-Bold.ttf"
        }

        Rectangle {
            id: translatePopup
            visible: false
            state: "loading"
            property int lastSeq: 0
            // Which flow currently owns the popup. The three-finger
            // translate round and rm-agent's corner-tap round share this
            // one popup (and so share one copy of the spinner animation
            // rather than a second, drifting copy of it), but they end
            // differently: translate swaps to the result card, thinking
            // just disappears. Whoever raised it is the only one allowed
            // to take it down.
            property string mode: "translate"
            property string loadingLabel: "翻译中…"
            property string originalText: ""
            property string translationText: ""
            property string exampleText: ""
            property string exampleTranslationText: ""
            // A whole marked sentence/paragraph comes back with no
            // EXAMPLE field (see prompts::TRANSLATE_PROMPT case B) — use
            // that as the signal to switch from the compact
            // dictionary-card layout to a wider, plain-weight passage
            // layout instead of a huge bolded word.
            property bool longMode: state === "done" && exampleText.length === 0 && translationText.length > 12
            z: 1000
            radius: 20
            color: "white"
            border.color: "#c0c0c0"
            border.width: 1.5
            width: state === "loading" ? 250 : Math.min(touchArea.width * (translatePopup.longMode ? 0.8 : 0.6), translatePopup.longMode ? 820 : 640)
            height: state === "loading" ? loadingRow.implicitHeight + 40 : popupColumn.implicitHeight + 48

            function readResultFile() {
                var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                try {
                    xhr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/xovi/exthome/translate/result.txt", false);
                    xhr.send();
                    return xhr.responseText || "";
                } catch (e) {
                    return "";
                }
            }

            // rm-agent detects the corner tap natively, in a separate
            // process that cannot call into QML, so it signals through a
            // one-byte state file the same way the translate round
            // signals results back — see rm_agent::thinking, which owns
            // the other end of this path.
            function readThinking() {
                var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                try {
                    xhr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/xovi/exthome/translate/thinking", false);
                    xhr.send();
                    return (xhr.responseText || "").indexOf("1") === 0;
                } catch (e) {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            function readSeq() {
                var raw = readResultFile();
                var n = parseInt(raw.split("\n")[0]);
                return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
            }

            MouseArea {
                anchors.fill: parent
                drag.target: translatePopup
                drag.axis: Drag.XAndYAxis
                drag.minimumX: 0
                drag.maximumX: touchArea.width - translatePopup.width
                drag.minimumY: 0
                drag.maximumY: touchArea.height - translatePopup.height
                onClicked: {
                    translatePopup.visible = false;
                    translatePollTimer.stop();
                    translateAutoCloseTimer.stop();
                }
            }

            Row {
                id: loadingRow
                visible: translatePopup.state === "loading"
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                spacing: 12

                Item {
                    // Same 12-ray sunburst shape/length distribution as
                    // rm-agent's own corner-tap "thinking" indicator (see
                    // evdev::sunburst_strokes / spinner.rs) — each ray's
                    // length comes from a fixed pseudo-random hash of its
                    // index, so the resting shape is organic rather than
                    // a mechanical, evenly-spaced pinwheel. Unlike the
                    // ink version, this animates a traveling *contraction
                    // wave* instead of rotating the whole shape: rays
                    // stay at fixed angles, and a wave center sweeps
                    // clockwise, dipping whichever ray it currently
                    // passes over and tapering back to full length a few
                    // rays out on either side — plus a small independent
                    // per-ray length wiggle (much smaller than the main
                    // wave's dip, disabled on whichever ray the wave is
                    // currently on top of) so the whole ring reads as
                    // gently squirming rather than one clean wave against
                    // otherwise-static rays. Ray thickness also varies
                    // per-ray (a third, independently-seeded hash) so
                    // rays don't read as uniform bars. Rendered via
                    // Canvas rather than a Repeater of Rectangles since
                    // per-ray varying width/length lines with round caps
                    // are far simpler to draw imperatively than to
                    // compose from QML primitives.
                    //
                    // Runs considerably faster than the old 45°/150ms
                    // rotation (per explicit direction to ignore e-ink
                    // refresh cost for now) — if ghosting turns out to be
                    // a real problem on-device, the first thing to try is
                    // raising SPIN_INTERVAL_MS below, not redesigning the
                    // shape/motion again.
                    id: spinnerIcon
                    width: 56
                    height: 56

                    Canvas {
                        id: spinnerCanvas
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        property real waveAngle: 0
                        property real t: 0

                        readonly property int numRays: 12
                        readonly property real baseAngleOffset: -Math.PI / 2
                        readonly property real dipStrength: 0.62
                        readonly property real dipWidthRad: (2 * Math.PI / numRays) * 1.6
                        readonly property real wiggleAmplitude: 0.12

                        function baseLenFrac(i) {
                            var seed = Math.sin(i * 12.9898) * 43758.5453;
                            var frac = seed - Math.floor(seed);
                            return 0.4 + 0.6 * frac;
                        }
                        function widthFrac(i) {
                            var seed = Math.sin(i * 39.425 + 1.618) * 98765.4321;
                            var frac = seed - Math.floor(seed);
                            return 0.65 + 0.6 * frac;
                        }
                        function wiggleParams(i) {
                            var seed = Math.sin(i * 78.233 + 4.71) * 12345.6789;
                            var frac = seed - Math.floor(seed);
                            return { freq: 0.5 + 1.1 * frac, phase: frac * 2 * Math.PI };
                        }
                        function angleDelta(a, b) {
                            var d = (a - b) % (2 * Math.PI);
                            if (d > Math.PI) d -= 2 * Math.PI;
                            if (d < -Math.PI) d += 2 * Math.PI;
                            return Math.abs(d);
                        }

                        onPaint: {
                            var ctx = getContext("2d");
                            var cx = width / 2, cy = height / 2;
                            var radius = (width / 2) * 0.9;
                            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
                            ctx.strokeStyle = "#222222";
                            ctx.lineCap = "round";
                            for (var i = 0; i < numRays; i++) {
                                var theta = baseAngleOffset + (2 * Math.PI * i) / numRays;
                                var d = angleDelta(theta, waveAngle);
                                var influence = d < dipWidthRad ? 0.5 * (1 + Math.cos(Math.PI * d / dipWidthRad)) : 0;
                                var wp = wiggleParams(i);
                                var wiggle = wiggleAmplitude * Math.sin(t * wp.freq + wp.phase);
                                var lenFrac = baseLenFrac(i) * (1 - dipStrength * influence) * (1 + wiggle * (1 - influence));
                                var len = radius * Math.max(0.12, lenFrac);
                                ctx.lineWidth = width * 0.055 * widthFrac(i);
                                var tipX = cx + len * Math.cos(theta);
                                var tipY = cy + len * Math.sin(theta);
                                ctx.beginPath();
                                ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
                                ctx.lineTo(tipX, tipY);
                                ctx.stroke();
                            }
                        }

                        Timer {
                            id: spinTimer
                            interval: 60
                            running: translatePopup.state === "loading" && translatePopup.visible
                            repeat: true
                            onTriggered: {
                                spinnerCanvas.waveAngle += (2 * Math.PI / spinnerCanvas.numRays) / 0.8;
                                spinnerCanvas.t += 0.35;
                                spinnerCanvas.requestPaint();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Text {
                    font.family: translateBoldFontLoader.name
                    font.pixelSize: 24
                    color: "#222222"
                    text: translatePopup.loadingLabel
                    // Row stacks its children on their top edges and has
                    // no vertical alignment of its own, so a ~30px label
                    // beside the 56px spinner sits visibly high. Anchors
                    // are not an option (Row rejects verticalCenter on
                    // its children); giving the label the spinner's
                    // height and centring the text within it is the
                    // positioner-safe equivalent.
                    height: spinnerIcon.height
                    verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                }
            }

            Column {
                id: popupColumn
                visible: translatePopup.state !== "loading"
                x: 28
                y: 24
                width: parent.width - 56
                spacing: 12

                Item {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: Math.max(headerLabel.implicitHeight, closeBtn.implicitHeight)

                    Text {
                        id: headerLabel
                        anchors.left: parent.left
                        anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                        text: "英译中"
                        font.family: translateBoldFontLoader.name
                        font.pixelSize: 22
                        color: "#222222"
                    }

                    Text {
                        id: closeBtn
                        anchors.right: parent.right
                        anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                        text: "×"
                        font.family: translateBoldFontLoader.name
                        font.pixelSize: 32
                        color: "#222222"

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            anchors.margins: -12
                            onClicked: {
                                translatePopup.visible = false;
                                translatePollTimer.stop();
                                translateAutoCloseTimer.stop();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Rectangle {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 1
                    color: "#e2e2e2"
                }

                Text {
                    id: originalTextEl
                    visible: translatePopup.originalText.length > 0
                    width: parent.width
                    text: translatePopup.originalText
                    font.family: translateBoldFontLoader.name
                    font.pixelSize: 26
                    color: "#111111"
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                }

                Text {
                    id: translationTextEl
                    width: parent.width
                    text: translatePopup.state === "loading" ? translatePopup.loadingLabel : translatePopup.translationText
                    font.family: translateBoldFontLoader.name
                    font.pixelSize: !translatePopup.longMode ? 48 : (translatePopup.translationText.length > 150 ? 26 : 32)
                    color: "black"
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                }

                Rectangle {
                    visible: translatePopup.exampleText.length > 0
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 1
                    color: "#eeeeee"
                }

                Text {
                    id: exampleTextEl
                    visible: translatePopup.exampleText.length > 0
                    width: parent.width
                    text: translatePopup.exampleText
                    textFormat: Text.RichText
                    font.family: translateBoldFontLoader.name
                    font.pixelSize: 25
                    color: "#000000"
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                }

                Text {
                    id: exampleTranslationTextEl
                    visible: translatePopup.exampleTranslationText.length > 0
                    width: parent.width
                    text: translatePopup.exampleTranslationText
                    textFormat: Text.RichText
                    font.family: translateBoldFontLoader.name
                    font.pixelSize: 23
                    color: "#1a1a1a"
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                }
            }
        }

        Timer {
            id: translatePollTimer
            interval: 300
            repeat: true
            property int elapsedMs: 0
            onTriggered: {
                elapsedMs += interval;
                var raw = translatePopup.readResultFile();
                var lines = raw.split("\n");
                var seq = parseInt(lines[0]);
                if (!isNaN(seq) && seq > translatePopup.lastSeq) {
                    translatePopup.originalText = lines.length > 1 ? lines[1] : "";
                    translatePopup.translationText = lines.length > 2 ? lines[2] : "";
                    translatePopup.exampleText = lines.length > 3 ? lines[3] : "";
                    translatePopup.exampleTranslationText = lines.length > 4 ? lines.slice(4).join("\n") : "";
                    translatePopup.state = "done";
                    translatePopup.x = (touchArea.width - translatePopup.width) / 2;
                    stop();
                    translateAutoCloseTimer.start();
                    return;
                }
                if (elapsedMs > 15000) {
                    translatePopup.originalText = "";
                    translatePopup.translationText = "(超时，请重试)";
                    translatePopup.exampleText = "";
                    translatePopup.exampleTranslationText = "";
                    translatePopup.state = "done";
                    translatePopup.x = (touchArea.width - translatePopup.width) / 2;
                    stop();
                    translateAutoCloseTimer.start();
                }
            }
        }

        Timer {
            id: translateAutoCloseTimer
            interval: 12000
            repeat: false
            onTriggered: {
                translatePopup.visible = false;
            }
        }

        // Corner-tap "thinking" indicator. Unlike the translate round,
        // which QML starts itself from the gesture and then polls only
        // until an answer lands, this one is started by a *native*
        // process (rm-agent watches the corners on the touch device),
        // so there is nothing to hook and this has to keep polling. Two
        // reads a second of a one-byte local file is cheap, but it is
        // the one thing here that runs while the device is otherwise
        // idle — raise the interval before adding anything else to it.
        Timer {
            id: thinkingPollTimer
            interval: 500
            repeat: true
            running: true
            property bool shown: false
            property int elapsedMs: 0
            // Same gap from the left edge as from the bottom one.
            readonly property int cornerMargin: 40
            onTriggered: {
                var on = translatePopup.readThinking();
                if (on && !shown) {
                    // A translate round already has the popup; let it
                    // finish rather than yanking the card away.
                    if (translatePopup.visible && translatePopup.mode === "translate") {
                        return;
                    }
                    shown = true;
                    elapsedMs = 0;
                    translatePopup.mode = "thinking";
                    translatePopup.loadingLabel = "思考中…";
                    translatePopup.state = "loading";
                    // Anchored to the bottom-left corner that was just
                    // tapped, rather than floating mid-screen like the
                    // translate card: the wait belongs to that corner
                    // button, and the ink indicator this replaced
                    // animated the corner icon itself. Equal left and
                    // bottom margins so it reads as deliberately placed
                    // instead of shoved into the corner. Only the
                    // bottom-left corner reaches Gemini (bottom-right
                    // starts a vocab review, which has its own UI), so
                    // the corner is fixed rather than passed in.
                    //
                    // Assigned after `state` because the popup's height
                    // is bound to it, and the bottom margin is measured
                    // from the resolved height.
                    translatePopup.x = thinkingPollTimer.cornerMargin;
                    translatePopup.y = touchArea.height - translatePopup.height - thinkingPollTimer.cornerMargin;
                    translatePopup.visible = true;
                    return;
                }
                if (shown) {
                    elapsedMs += interval;
                    // The deadline is a backstop for rm-agent dying
                    // between raising and clearing the flag; it clears
                    // the file on startup too, so this only matters
                    // until it is next restarted.
                    if (!on || elapsedMs > 120000) {
                        shown = false;
                        if (translatePopup.mode === "thinking") {
                            translatePopup.visible = false;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // --- Vocab review (Anki-style flashcards) ---
        // Triggered externally by rm-agent's bottom-right corner tap
        // (see docmeta.rs + main.rs), not by any gesture in this file —
        // vocabPoller runs continuously in the background watching for
        // vocab_daemon to start a session, independent of the translate
        // gesture above.

        CommandExecutor {
            id: vocabGoodCmd
        }
        CommandExecutor {
            id: vocabAgainCmd
        }

        Rectangle {
            id: vocabPopup
            visible: false
            z: 1001
            radius: 20
            color: "white"
            border.color: "#c0c0c0"
            border.width: 1.5
            property string cardState: "front"
            property string word: ""
            property string translationText: ""
            property string exampleText: ""
            property string exampleTranslationText: ""
            property string message: ""
            width: Math.min(touchArea.width * 0.6, 640)
            height: vocabColumn.implicitHeight + 48

            MouseArea {
                anchors.fill: parent
                drag.target: vocabPopup
                drag.axis: Drag.XAndYAxis
                drag.minimumX: 0
                drag.maximumX: touchArea.width - vocabPopup.width
                drag.minimumY: 0
                drag.maximumY: touchArea.height - vocabPopup.height
                onClicked: {
                    if (vocabPopup.cardState === "front") {
                        vocabPopup.cardState = "back";
                    }
                }
            }

            Column {
                id: vocabColumn
                x: 28
                y: 24
                width: parent.width - 56
                spacing: 14

                Item {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: Math.max(vocabHeaderLabel.implicitHeight, vocabCloseBtn.implicitHeight)

                    Text {
                        id: vocabHeaderLabel
                        anchors.left: parent.left
                        anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                        text: "复习"
                        font.family: translateBoldFontLoader.name
                        font.pixelSize: 22
                        color: "#222222"
                    }

                    Text {
                        id: vocabCloseBtn
                        anchors.right: parent.right
                        anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                        text: "×"
                        font.family: translateBoldFontLoader.name
                        font.pixelSize: 32
                        color: "#222222"

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            anchors.margins: -12
                            onClicked: vocabPopup.visible = false
                        }
                    }
                }

                Rectangle {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 1
                    color: "#e2e2e2"
                }

                Text {
                    width: parent.width
                    visible: vocabPopup.cardState !== "message"
                    text: vocabPopup.word
                    font.family: translateBoldFontLoader.name
                    font.pixelSize: 44
                    color: "black"
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                }

                Text {
                    width: parent.width
                    visible: vocabPopup.cardState === "front"
                    text: "点击卡片查看背面"
                    font.family: translateBoldFontLoader.name
                    font.pixelSize: 20
                    color: "#8a8a8a"
                }

                Text {
                    width: parent.width
                    visible: vocabPopup.cardState === "back"
                    text: vocabPopup.translationText
                    font.family: translateBoldFontLoader.name
                    font.pixelSize: 32
                    color: "#222222"
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                }

                Text {
                    width: parent.width
                    visible: vocabPopup.cardState === "back" && vocabPopup.exampleText.length > 0
                    text: vocabPopup.exampleText
                    textFormat: Text.RichText
                    font.family: translateBoldFontLoader.name
                    font.pixelSize: 22
                    color: "#333333"
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                }

                Text {
                    width: parent.width
                    visible: vocabPopup.cardState === "back" && vocabPopup.exampleTranslationText.length > 0
                    text: vocabPopup.exampleTranslationText
                    textFormat: Text.RichText
                    font.family: translateBoldFontLoader.name
                    font.pixelSize: 20
                    color: "#555555"
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                }

                Text {
                    width: parent.width
                    visible: vocabPopup.cardState === "message"
                    text: vocabPopup.message
                    font.family: translateBoldFontLoader.name
                    font.pixelSize: 26
                    color: "#222222"
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                }

                Row {
                    visible: vocabPopup.cardState === "back"
                    spacing: 16
                    width: parent.width

                    Rectangle {
                        width: (parent.width - 16) / 2
                        height: 56
                        radius: 12
                        color: "#f5f5f5"
                        border.color: "#c0c0c0"
                        border.width: 1.5

                        Text {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            text: "不认识"
                            font.family: translateBoldFontLoader.name
                            font.pixelSize: 24
                            color: "#222222"
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            onClicked: {
                                vocabAgainCmd.executeCommand("/bin/touch", ["/home/root/vocab/review_action_again"]);
                                vocabPopup.cardState = "front";
                                vocabPopup.word = "…";
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Rectangle {
                        width: (parent.width - 16) / 2
                        height: 56
                        radius: 12
                        color: "#222222"

                        Text {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            text: "认识"
                            font.family: translateBoldFontLoader.name
                            font.pixelSize: 24
                            color: "white"
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            onClicked: {
                                vocabGoodCmd.executeCommand("/bin/touch", ["/home/root/vocab/review_action_good"]);
                                vocabPopup.cardState = "front";
                                vocabPopup.word = "…";
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Timer {
            id: vocabPoller
            interval: 400
            running: true
            repeat: true
            property int lastSeenSeq: 0
            onTriggered: {
                var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                var raw = "";
                try {
                    xhr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/vocab/review_result", false);
                    xhr.send();
                    raw = xhr.responseText || "";
                } catch (e) {
                    return;
                }
                var lines = raw.split("\n");
                var seq = parseInt(lines[0]);
                if (isNaN(seq) || seq <= lastSeenSeq) {
                    return;
                }
                lastSeenSeq = seq;

                var status = lines.length > 1 ? lines[1] : "";
                if (status === "card") {
                    vocabPopup.word = lines.length > 2 ? lines[2] : "";
                    vocabPopup.translationText = lines.length > 3 ? lines[3] : "";
                    vocabPopup.exampleText = lines.length > 4 ? lines[4] : "";
                    vocabPopup.exampleTranslationText = lines.length > 5 ? lines.slice(5).join("\n") : "";
                    vocabPopup.cardState = "front";
                    vocabPopup.x = (touchArea.width - vocabPopup.width) / 2;
                    vocabPopup.y = touchArea.height * 0.3;
                    vocabPopup.visible = true;
                } else if (status === "empty") {
                    vocabPopup.cardState = "message";
                    vocabPopup.message = "这本书暂时没有需要复习的单词";
                    vocabPopup.x = (touchArea.width - vocabPopup.width) / 2;
                    vocabPopup.y = touchArea.height * 0.3;
                    vocabPopup.visible = true;
                    vocabAutoCloseTimer.start();
                } else if (status === "done") {
                    vocabPopup.cardState = "message";
                    vocabPopup.message = "今天的复习完成了！";
                    vocabPopup.x = (touchArea.width - vocabPopup.width) / 2;
                    vocabPopup.y = touchArea.height * 0.3;
                    vocabPopup.visible = true;
                    vocabAutoCloseTimer.start();
                }
            }
        }

        Timer {
            id: vocabAutoCloseTimer
            interval: 4000
            repeat: false
            onTriggered: vocabPopup.visible = false
        }
    }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
